title.narrative: Rafforzamento della Risposta Umanitaria alla crisi dei Grandi Laghi in Repubblica Democratica del Congo - Fase II
Strengthening Humanitarian Response to the Great Lakes crisis in Democratic Republic of Congo - 2nd phase

description.narrative: La presente Iniziativa mira a rispondere ai bisogni urgenti e a promuovere il miglioramento delle condizioni socioeconomiche degli sfollati interni e delle comunità ospitanti colpite dalla crisi umanitaria nella regione dei Grandi Laghi in RDC. Particolare attenzione sarà dedicata alle persone con disabilità, alle donne e ai minori, attraverso il sostegno a progetti presentati da OSC.

This Initiative seeks to address urgent needs and support the improvement of the socio-economic conditions of internally displaced persons and host communities affected by the humanitarian crisis in the Great Lakes region in DRC. Special attention will be given to persons with disabilities, women, and children, through the funding of projects submitted by Civil Society Organizations (CSOs).

tag.narrative: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls

By 2030, end hunger and ensure access by all people, in particular the poor and people in vulnerable situations, including infants, to safe, nutritious and sufficient food all year round

End all forms of discrimination against all women and girls everywhere
End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition and promote sustainable agriculture
End poverty in all its forms everywhere
Reduce inequality within and among countries
